shared: negative regulation of G0 to G1 transition

reading_1.theme: Cellular senescence and proliferative arrest
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of senescence (oncogene-induced) and blocking cell-cycle re-entry, framed as the arrest arm of senescence that is accompanied by SASP secretion and Polycomb-controlled CDKN2A silencing.

reading_2.theme: Oncogene-induced cellular senescence
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the induction of senescence and arrest of cell-cycle re-entry by oncogenic signalling, which is executed through senescence-associated heterochromatin formation.

shared: negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance
positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance

reading_1.theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame netrin signalling with attractive and repulsive control of axon extension as the guidance mechanism, extended by second-messenger signalling, collateral sprouting and sensory ganglion development.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by netrin, Slit-Robo and ephrin signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are netrin-mediated attraction/repulsion and control of axon extension, alongside Slit-Robo and ephrin repulsion converging on Rho-GTPase cytoskeletal regulation.

shared: innate activation by cytosolic DNA sensing

reading_1.theme: Innate antiviral nucleic-acid sensing and interferon response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways (cytosolic DNA sensing, OAS, IP-10, cellular response to virus and IFN-alpha) are framed here as the interferon-effector and DNA-sensing response that sits downstream of and alongside RIG-I/IRF3 RNA sensing in dendritic cells.

reading_2.theme: Type I interferon antiviral response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are virus and cytosolic DNA sensing and IFN-alpha effector responses (OAS, IP-10), framed as the innate antiviral interferon programme.

shared: Regulation of TP53 Activity through Methylation

reading_1.theme: Protein methylation linked to ribosome biogenesis and translation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover lysine and arginine methylation of proteins, including p53, responding to methionine availability. Here this is a nutrient-sensitive modification layer regulating ribosome biogenesis and cap-dependent translation initiation.

reading_2.theme: Protein lysine and arginine methylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are protein methyltransferase activity on lysine and arginine residues (including TP53 methylation) linked to methionine sensing, which this theme connects to ribosome biogenesis and cap-dependent translation initiation.

reading_1.theme: Somitogenesis and segmentation clock
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe somite formation and segmental compartment patterning (including LFNG clock defects), framed as the core of somite specification, rostrocaudal polarity and axis elongation.

reading_2.theme: Notch O-glycosylation in somite segmentation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe somitogenesis and its LFNG-linked disease, framed as Notch-dependent segmentation patterning that depends on O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch in the ER and Golgi.

shared: Recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins and complexes
Loss of Nlp from mitotic centrosomes
FBXL7 down-regulates AURKA during mitotic entry and in early mitosis
Regulation of PLK1 Activity at G2/M Transition
Recruitment of NuMA to mitotic centrosomes

reading_1.theme: Mitotic spindle assembly through cytokinesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover AURKA/PLK1 control of mitotic entry, centrosome maturation and spindle assembly, framed as early mitosis upstream of spindle elongation and cytokinetic ring formation.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic centrosome and spindle assembly regulated by Aurora A/PLK1
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the Aurora A/TPX2 and PLK1 kinase control of centrosome maturation and spindle assembly at mitotic entry, framed as the core of a broader spindle-formation and checkpoint machinery including Ran, NEK kinases and kinetochore signalling.

reading_1.theme: Hexosamine pathway and sialic acid metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the hexosamine biosynthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its congenital myasthenic defects (GFPT1, ALG14), the precursor supply for sialic acid synthesis.

reading_2.theme: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are hexosamine pathway synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its congenital myasthenic syndrome defects, framed as the glycosylation precursor supply within amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism.

shared: positive regulation of long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity

reading_1.theme: Postsynaptic structural plasticity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover long-term plasticity and local translation at the synapse. Here these act to remodel the postsynapse through actin organisation, PSD maintenance and delivery of neurotransmitter receptors.

reading_2.theme: Synaptic plasticity and postsynaptic structure
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are activity-dependent synaptic plasticity and local synaptic translation, implemented through postsynaptic actin, density structure and receptor trafficking.

shared: Defective GNE causes sialuria, NK and IBM2
Attachment of GPI anchor to uPAR
Defective SLC35A1 in sialic acid metabolism causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
attachment of GPI anchor to protein

reading_1.theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport for glycoconjugates
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucose, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis, framed as the sugar-donor supply and its use whose Golgi transport by SLC35 carriers fails in CDGs.

reading_2.theme: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis: sialic acid, GPI anchors, glycosphingolipids
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the synthesis of nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid) and their use to build GPI anchors and glycosphingolipids, with their Golgi transport and congenital glycosylation disorders.

shared: Defective SLC4A1 causes hereditary spherocytosis type 4 (HSP4),  distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) and dRTA with hemolytic anemia (dRTA-HA)
Defective SLC4A4 causes renal tubular acidosis, proximal, with ocular abnormalities and mental retardation (pRTA-OA)

reading_1.theme: Bicarbonate transport and acid-base/organellar pH regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover SLC4 bicarbonate transporters and their renal tubular acidosis disorders, framed as acid-base homeostasis alongside V-ATPase lumen acidification and carbonic anhydrase CO2 hydration.

reading_2.theme: SLC anion and ion transporters and their disorders in mineralization
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects in renal tubular acidosis, framed as part of a wider set of SLC ion transporters (phosphate, calcium exchangers) governing pH and mineralization of tooth enamel and tissues.

reading_1.theme: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodeling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are de novo synthesis and transfer of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin, complemented by Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodeling and phospholipid hydrolysis.

reading_2.theme: Phospholipid biosynthesis, remodelling and membrane distribution
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling of the main glycerophospholipid classes, including cardiolipin, as membrane lipid production whose transfer, scrambling and translocation the additional pathways describe.

shared: regulation of entry of bacterium into host cell
biological process involved in interaction with symbiont
Attachment of bacteria to epithelial cells
obsolete cytolysis by host of symbiont cells

reading_1.theme: Innate mucosal defence against bacterial attachment and invasion
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame antimicrobial host defence at epithelial surfaces (metal sequestration, agglutination, killing of Gram-positive bacteria, control of bacterial attachment and entry), here as the host side of the bacterial invasion exemplified by Listeria's actin-driven entry.

reading_2.theme: Mucosal innate antibacterial defence
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are host antimicrobial effector mechanisms at epithelial surfaces (bacterial agglutination, metal sequestration, killing of Gram-positive bacteria, control of bacterial attachment and entry), framed as defence against invasive bacteria such as Listeria.

shared: Recruitment of NuMA to mitotic centrosomes
Loss of Nlp from mitotic centrosomes
Recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins and complexes

reading_1.theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover recruiting pericentriolar proteins and NuMA to mitotic centrosomes and activating Aurora A by TPX2. This builds the centrosome into the organizing hub that nucleates astral microtubules and assembles, positions and orients the mitotic spindle.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle positioning
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome maturation at mitotic entry (recruitment of NuMA and pericentriolar proteins, loss of Nlp, TPX2-dependent Aurora A activation), which here supplies the astral microtubules and spindle assembly needed to position and orient the spindle.

shared: regulation of short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity

reading_1.theme: Glutamatergic synaptic transmission via AMPA and kainate receptors
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are AMPA receptor regulation, clustering and diffusion trapping, framed as postsynaptic excitatory transmission modulated by presynaptic kainate receptors and G-protein channel control.

reading_2.theme: AMPA receptor trafficking in excitatory synaptic plasticity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and short-term plasticity at glutamatergic synapses, framed as the synaptic mechanism underlying simple learning.

shared: Signaling by CSF1 (M-CSF) in myeloid cells
regulation of response to macrophage colony-stimulating factor

reading_1.theme: M-CSF signalling in macrophage and myeloid differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are CSF1 receptor and related interleukin receptor signalling driving macrophage proliferation, framed as the cytokine trigger for monocyte, macrophage and dendritic-cell differentiation alongside GM-CSF and G-CSF.

reading_2.theme: CSF1 and IL-6-family cytokine receptor signalling via STAT and ERK
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are M-CSF/CSF1 and interleukin SHC signalling controlling macrophage proliferation, framed as one cytokine-receptor input converging with gp130 IL-6-family cytokines on JAK-STAT3 and ERK.

shared: protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere

reading_1.theme: Telomere protection and maintenance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover shelterin-type end protection (capping telomeres, blocking NHEJ and limiting t-circle formation). This is the protective arm that sits alongside telomerase-mediated extension, C-strand fill-in synthesis and ATRX/DAXX-dependent suppression of telomeric recombination.

reading_2.theme: Telomere protection and telomerase-dependent maintenance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are telomere capping and protection against NHEJ and t-circle formation, the end-protection function forming the protective side of telomere maintenance alongside recombination suppression, telomerase recruitment and C-strand synthesis.

shared: positive regulation of high-density lipoprotein particle clearance

reading_1.theme: HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and nascent HDL assembly (and its loss in Tangier disease), the first step of reverse cholesterol transport, which the additional terms extend to LXR-regulated efflux, lipoprotein remodelling and foam-cell restraint.

reading_2.theme: HDL assembly and reverse cholesterol transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and nascent HDL formation as the initiating step of reverse cholesterol transport, upstream of lipoprotein remodeling and LXR-regulated macrophage lipid homeostasis.

shared: positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation
positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cells and osteoblasts
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Wnt signalling driving mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, the progenitor commitment step upstream of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation (bone formation).

reading_2.theme: Wnt-driven mesenchymal stem cell osteoblast differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Wnt signalling promoting mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, framed as the upstream drive of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in bone formation.

reading_1.theme: Phospholipid synthesis and membrane lipid translocation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe flippase/scramblase movement and transfer of phospholipids between leaflets and membranes, framed as the distribution step for phospholipids (PS, PE, PC, PG, cardiolipin) synthesized and remodeled elsewhere.

reading_2.theme: Membrane phospholipid translocation and intermembrane lipid transfer
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation and intermembrane lipid transfer, framed as membrane lipid organisation underlying vesicular traffic and PI and glycolipid transport.

shared: IRF3-mediated induction of type I IFN
SARS-CoV-2 activates/modulates innate and adaptive immune responses
NF-kB activation through FADD/RIP-1 pathway mediated by caspase-8 and -10
IRF3 mediated activation of type 1 IFN
positive regulation of RIG-I signaling pathway
positive regulation of defense response to virus by host
Modulation of host responses by IFN-stimulated genes
Regulation of TBK1, IKKε (IKBKE)-mediated activation of IRF3, IRF7
positive regulation of type I interferon-mediated signaling pathway
Evasion by RSV of host interferon responses
Regulation of TBK1, IKKε-mediated activation of IRF3, IRF7 upon TLR3 ligation

reading_1.theme: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the RIG-I/MDA5-MAVS-TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 signalling axis (with TRAF3/TRAF6 adaptors, OTU deubiquitinase regulators and viral evasion of it), which this theme frames as the central cytosolic RNA-sensor relay that converts viral dsRNA detection into type I interferon and NF-kB output, alongside the DNA-sensing, TLR and inflammasome arms in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: RIG-I-like receptor and TLR3 signalling to type I interferon
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the full innate antiviral cascade (RLR/TLR3 sensing, TRAF3/6, TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/7 and NF-kB, viral evasion), framed as the signalling upstream of ISG15-mediated antiviral effector mechanisms.

shared: Organic anion transport by SLC5/17/25 transporters
Sodium-coupled sulphate, di- and tri-carboxylate transporters

reading_1.theme: Membrane transport of metabolic carboxylates and carnitine
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled SLC13/SLC25-type carriers moving succinate and other TCA-cycle di/tricarboxylates, framed here as one arm of a broader system shuttling fuel intermediates (pyruvate, monocarboxylates, alpha-ketoglutarate, carnitine) across membranes, notably in the kidney proximal tubule.

reading_2.theme: Dicarboxylate transport and glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled and SLC-mediated transport of succinate, citrate and other di/tricarboxylates, framed here as the carrier layer that moves TCA intermediates for the malate-aspartate shuttle and glutamate/glutamine nitrogen metabolism.

shared: negative regulation of cytokine production involved in inflammatory response
negative regulation of interleukin-1 alpha production
negative regulation of interleukin-1 beta production

reading_1.theme: Negative regulation of IL-1 and TLR inflammatory signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the dampening of IL-1 family signalling and IL-1/IL-12 cytokine production as anti-inflammatory restraint on Toll/IL-1 receptor pathways, extended to TLR2/4 and LPS signalling.

reading_2.theme: Inflammasome activation and interleukin-1 regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe restraint of IL-1, IL-12 and Toll-driven inflammatory cytokine production, framed as the negative-control side of NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing.

shared: retrograde vesicle-mediated transport, Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum

reading_1.theme: Golgi vesicle trafficking and Golgi organisation
reading_1.core_role: The shared COPI-dependent vesicle budding and retrograde/anterograde transport pathways are the core vesicle traffic that maintains Golgi structure, retention and secretion, including its disassembly and reassembly.

reading_2.theme: COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover COPI vesicle budding for Golgi-to-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi anterograde transport. Here this trafficking engine maintains Golgi structure, ribbon assembly and disassembly, and constitutive secretion.

shared: enriched in naive and memory B cells

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.

reading_1.theme: B cell activation and differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame B cell and activated lymphocyte transcriptional signatures as the lineage identity on which B cell proliferation, differentiation and plasma cell generation act.

reading_2.theme: B cell identity and differentiation to plasma cells
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover B-cell transcriptional module signatures marking the naive/memory B lymphocyte compartment and lymphoid activation. This is the starting compartment that germinal centre differentiation turns into memory B cells and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells.

shared: aspartate family amino acid biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: One-carbon, folate and nucleotide metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the folate and methionine cycles, covering tetrahydrofolate interconversion, formate and 10-formyl-THF, SAM and methionine salvage (and their defects), the one-carbon supply that feeds de novo purine and thymidylate synthesis within the nucleotide metabolism of the additional set.

reading_2.theme: One-carbon folate-methionine metabolism and nucleotide synthesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the folate and methionine/SAM one-carbon cycle, framed as the supplier of one-carbon units for de novo purine and thymidylate synthesis and nucleotide metabolism.

shared: antigen processing and presentation, endogenous lipid antigen via MHC class Ib

reading_1.theme: MHC antigen processing and presentation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are general antigen processing and presentation including CD1/MHC-Ib lipid presentation, framed within MHC class II presentation of exogenous antigens by B cells and other APCs.

reading_2.theme: Antigen processing and presentation by MHC molecules
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are general and MHC class I/Ib antigen presentation (including lipid antigens), complemented by MHC class II presentation of exogenous peptides in B cells.

shared: clearance of foreign intracellular nucleic acids
host-mediated suppression of viral genome replication
negative regulation of single stranded viral RNA replication via double stranded DNA intermediate

reading_1.theme: Host restriction of retroviruses and viral genome control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe APOBEC-mediated cytidine deamination and editing and host suppression of viral genome replication, framed here as the intrinsic antiretroviral restriction (countered by HIV Vif) that acts on the reverse-transcription, integration and latency steps of the viral life cycle in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Nucleic acid base editing and demethylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC cytidine deamination used as antiviral restriction of viral genomes, within the broader theme of enzymatic base editing (ADAR) and DNA demethylation/alkylation reversal.

shared: negative regulation of monocyte chemotactic protein-1 production
negative regulation of macrophage cytokine production

reading_1.theme: Monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and recruitment
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte activation and proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine (MCP-1) output and its restraint, set within monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation, RAGE and scavenger receptor sensing and p38 signalling.

reading_2.theme: Monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and recruitment
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover monocyte activation and proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine output, including negative regulation of MCP-1 and macrophage cytokines. Here they are the tunable signal driving monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and RAGE/scavenger receptor-triggered recruitment.

shared: cardiac muscle cell-cardiac muscle cell adhesion
regulation of cardiac muscle contraction by regulation of the release of sequestered calcium ion
membrane depolarization during SA node cell action potential
regulation of cardiac muscle cell action potential involved in regulation of contraction
regulation of SA node cell action potential
regulation of membrane repolarization during ventricular cardiac muscle cell action potential
regulation of atrial cardiac muscle cell membrane depolarization
membrane repolarization during atrial cardiac muscle cell action potential
regulation of heart rate by cardiac conduction
bundle of His cell to Purkinje myocyte signaling
regulation of ventricular cardiac muscle cell membrane depolarization
regulation of ventricular cardiac muscle cell action potential
obsolete cell-cell signaling involved in cardiac conduction
regulation of atrial cardiac muscle cell membrane repolarization
Purkinje myocyte to ventricular cardiac muscle cell communication
regulation of membrane depolarization during cardiac muscle cell action potential
membrane depolarization during AV node cell action potential
regulation of cardiac muscle cell membrane potential
regulation of heart rate by chemical signal

reading_1.theme: Cardiac electrophysiology and calcium handling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the cardiac action potential phases, pacemaking and conduction through SA/AV nodes and the His-Purkinje system, framed as the electrical excitation that, through ion channels and calcium handling, drives contraction.

reading_2.theme: Cardiac electrophysiology and conduction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cardiac action potential phases, pacemaker and conduction-system signalling, framed as the electrical basis of heart rhythm along with His-Purkinje development and gap-junction coupling.

shared: apoptotic process involved in heart morphogenesis
TFAP2 (AP-2) family regulates transcription of other transcription factors
cardiac neural crest cell migration involved in outflow tract morphogenesis
regulation of secondary heart field cardioblast proliferation
embryonic heart tube left/right pattern formation

reading_1.theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis and outflow tract development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover heart tube patterning, second heart field and cardiac neural crest contributions, ventricle formation, and outflow tract septation with great artery morphogenesis. This is the structural morphogenesis that atrioventricular and conduction system development extend.

reading_2.theme: Embryonic heart development and cardiac morphogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover morphogenesis of the heart tube, ventricles, septa, outflow tract and great arteries from the second heart field and cardiac neural crest. Alongside them, the additional pathways specify the cardiac conduction system.

shared: regulation of telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage

reading_1.theme: Telomere maintenance via replication and recombination
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are DNA topology remodelling, replication fork reversal and strand elongation control, used here as the fork-processing machinery that replicates telomeres and resolves telomeric D-loops and recombination intermediates.

reading_2.theme: Telomere maintenance and DNA structural transactions
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are DNA topology and geometry changes, replication fork reversal and regulation of strand elongation, framed as the DNA mechanics used for telomere replication and recombination-based telomere maintenance.

shared: obsolete glutamine family amino acid metabolic process

reading_1.theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and organic acid metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the glutamate/glutamine/2-oxoglutarate nitrogen hub (with proline and aspartate interconversions), serving as the central amino-nitrogen node that feeds glycine, glyoxylate and dicarboxylate metabolism and glutamine/glycine conjugation of xenobiotic acids.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate/glutamine nitrogen metabolism and ammonia detoxification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate interconversion and nitrogen utilisation, framed as nitrogen handling that feeds the urea cycle and ammonium homeostasis.

shared: Cholesterol biosynthesis from zymosterol (modified Kandutsch-Russell pathway)
obsolete cholesterol biosynthetic process via desmosterol
isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway

reading_1.theme: Isoprenoid and sterol biosynthesis with vitamin K/quinone metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the mevalonate-isoprenoid route to cholesterol (lanosterol, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell), framed as the source of prenyl precursors also used for ubiquinone and vitamin K quinones that support gamma-carboxylation.

reading_2.theme: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism and cholesterol biosynthesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mevalonate/isoprenoid and sterol biosynthesis, framed as lipid synthesis alongside peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, plasmalogen synthesis and peroxisome biogenesis.

shared: SLBP independent Processing of Histone Pre-mRNAs
mRNA 3'-end processing by stem-loop binding and cleavage
SLBP Dependent Processing of Replication-Dependent Histone Pre-mRNAs

reading_1.theme: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are 3'-end processing and termination of replication-dependent histone pre-mRNAs, the maturation step preceding nuclear export of mature mRNAs.

reading_2.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear export
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover 3'-end maturation of replication-dependent histone mRNAs (SLBP stem-loop binding and cleavage) and Pol II termination. This is the processing step that makes transcripts competent for export through the nuclear pore.

shared: positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

reading_1.theme: Pre-mRNA splicing and 3'-end processing
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the spliceosome and snRNA cap hypermethylation, framed as snRNP-based splicing machinery within co-transcriptional mRNA maturation including polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing.

reading_2.theme: Spliceosome assembly and snRNA production for mRNA splicing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are spliceosome activity and snRNA cap hypermethylation, framed as the snRNP maturation and core splicing step fed by Pol II/III snRNA transcription and tri-snRNP assembly.

reading_1.theme: Histone methylation and chromatin remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are histone lysine methylation/demethylation and CHD1/2 chromatin remodellers, framed here among chromatin-modifying complexes (PKMTs, CHD, NuRD, HDACs) controlling heterochromatin and gene expression.

reading_2.theme: Histone modification and chromatin remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are histone lysine methylation and demethylation plus CHD1/2 remodellers, framed as writers, erasers and remodellers setting epigenetic chromatin state alongside NuRD, HDACs and KMT complexes.

shared: Constitutive Signaling by AKT1 E17K in Cancer
Synthesis of pyrophosphates in the cytosol
Synthesis of IPs in the nucleus
Synthesis of PIPs in the nucleus

reading_1.theme: Inositol phosphate and phosphoinositide signalling via PI3K/AKT
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe nuclear and cytosolic inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis and oncogenic AKT activation, framed as part of PI3K/AKT/PTEN signalling and its loss of control in cancer.

reading_2.theme: Inositol phosphate signalling and PI3K/AKT regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear phosphoinositide and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis plus oncogenic AKT1 activation, framed as the lipid-messenger signalling that feeds and regulates the PI3K/AKT/PTEN axis.

shared: SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover Sema3A-plexin signalling (via PAK, CRMPs and integrin inhibition) that repels and steers growing axons. This sits within wider axon guidance and collateral-sprouting control, including netrin repulsion.

reading_2.theme: Semaphorin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A-plexin repulsion and semaphorin interactions in axonogenesis and sympathetic innervation, framed as the guidance signals controlling axon extension and collateral sprouting.

shared: Defective SLC4A4 causes renal tubular acidosis, proximal, with ocular abnormalities and mental retardation (pRTA-OA)
Defective SLC4A1 causes hereditary spherocytosis type 4 (HSP4),  distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) and dRTA with hemolytic anemia (dRTA-HA)

reading_1.theme: Acid-base anion and proton exchange across membranes
reading_1.core_role: The shared bicarbonate transporters and their SLC4 disease defects are the core bicarbonate-handling arm of systemic and cellular pH regulation, alongside SLC26 anion exchangers, NHE proton exchangers and carbonic anhydrase.

reading_2.theme: Anion exchange and acid-base transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects (renal tubular acidosis, spherocytosis), framed as acid-base and pH regulation alongside SLC26 anion exchangers, sodium/proton exchangers and carbonic anhydrase.

shared: obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission

reading_1.theme: Catecholamine synthesis and transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine synthesis and synaptic catecholamine reuptake regulation, the neurotransmitter production and recycling side of monoamine handling alongside dopamine and norepinephrine transport.

reading_2.theme: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic reuptake
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover dopamine biosynthesis and the regulation of presynaptic catecholamine metabolism and reuptake. Here they are the transmitter-supply side, coupled to monoamine (dopamine/norepinephrine) membrane transport.

shared: positive regulation of type II interferon production
positive regulation of dendritic cell cytokine production

reading_1.theme: Dendritic cell cytokine responses to pathogens
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover dendritic cell IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production in response to protozoa, framed as the cytokine output of C-type lectin receptor (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) pathogen recognition.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell IL-12/IFN-gamma drive of Th1 immunity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe activated dendritic cell production of IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF, framed as the innate cytokine signal that polarises Th1 differentiation and enhances MHC antigen presentation.

shared: mesenchymal stem cell maintenance involved in nephron morphogenesis
negative regulation of apoptotic process involved in development
obsolete cell differentiation involved in metanephros development
negative regulation of mesenchymal cell apoptotic process
regulation of mesenchymal to epithelial transition involved in metanephros morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Metanephric mesenchyme survival and nephron differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe maintenance, survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion of nephron progenitors, framed as the controls on kidney growth, size and tubular differentiation.

reading_2.theme: Metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and kidney size control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover nephron progenitor survival, maintenance and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into tubules, framed as the cellular mechanism by which nephron number and kidney size are set and restrained.

shared: aspartate family amino acid biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Methionine cycle and methyl-group metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame methionine synthesis, salvage and the S-adenosylmethionine cycle (with its inherited defects) as the central methyl-donor metabolism, linked to choline and carnitine metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Methionine cycle and cobalamin/folate one-carbon metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the methionine/SAM cycle and its inherited defects, framed as the methylation endpoint that depends on cobalamin and folate supply for remethylation of homocysteine.

reading_1.theme: Aspartate-glutamate transamination linking carbon and nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism, framed as the hub that links glutamate, aspartate and alanine transamination with gluconeogenesis and mitochondrial NADH transfer.

reading_2.theme: Dicarboxylate and organic anion transport across membranes
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism, read as a dicarboxylate exchange system within broader membrane transport of TCA intermediates and organic anions.

reading_1.theme: Selective autophagy and clearance of misfolded protein aggregates
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are selective autophagy routes (microautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, aggrephagy, ATG8 delipidation), used here as the degradative disposal arm for misfolded proteins gathered into perinuclear aggresomes.

reading_2.theme: Selective autophagy clearing misfolded protein aggregates
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the autophagy routes (aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated, microautophagy, nutrient-responsive autophagy) framed as the degradation machinery that clears aggresome-sequestered misfolded proteins.

shared: Defective HK1 causes hexokinase deficiency (HK deficiency)

reading_1.theme: Hepatic carbohydrate metabolism: fructose, glycerol, glucose and glycogen
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe fructose and glycerol/polyol metabolism and its inherited defects, framed as entry routes feeding glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Hepatic hexose-phosphate metabolism: fructose, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the fructose and glycerol entry routes (fructokinase, aldolase B, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate) and their inborn errors. Here they act as feeders into the hexose- and triose-phosphate pools used by glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen metabolism.

reading_1.theme: Neutrophil recruitment, chemotaxis and extravasation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are diapedesis and neutrophil migration/extravasation, framed as the transendothelial step of neutrophil recruitment driven by formyl-peptide and chemotactic GPCR signalling.

reading_2.theme: Leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe neutrophil migration and diapedesis as the endpoint of integrin- and PECAM1-mediated adhesion that also governs T-cell extravasation, polarity and synapse formation.

reading_1.theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis and anion transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are iodide uptake via NIS and thyroid hormone generation and transport, the hormonogenesis core that relies on pendrin/SLC26 anion exchange and H2O2 for iodide organification.

reading_2.theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis: iodide uptake, peroxide and anion exchange
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the thyroid-specific core of hormonogenesis, NIS-mediated iodide uptake and thyroid hormone generation and transport, which the theme supports with H2O2 generation and SLC26 (pendrin-type) anion exchange.

shared: negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay
positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly
Insulin-like Growth Factor-2 mRNA Binding Proteins (IGF2BPs/IMPs/VICKZs) bind RNA

reading_1.theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and decay
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover mRNA stabilization by RNA-binding proteins (IGF2BP, CRD-mediated) and promotion of cytoplasmic translation. They are the stabilizing counterweight to ARE-directed deadenylation and decapping decay driven by TTP, KSRP, AUF1 and BRF1.

reading_2.theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and decay
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the mRNA-stabilising, pro-translation side of cytoplasmic mRNA turnover, with IGF2BP and CRD binding, inhibition of deadenylation-dependent decay, P-body assembly and translational activation, set against the AU-rich element destabilisers, deadenylation, decapping and decay pathways in the additional set.

reading_1.theme: PAX3/AP-2 transcriptional control of neural crest cadherins
reading_1.core_role: The shared PAX3 target sets frame PAX3 as the transcription factor whose targets, together with AP-2 and DNA-binding regulation, control cadherin (CDH1, CDH11, CDH19) expression in neural crest-derived cells.

reading_2.theme: PAX3 and neural crest transcription factor regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 target gene sets, which here represent a neural-crest/developmental transcription factor programme alongside AP-2 regulation and cadherin (CDH1, CDH11, CDH19) gene control and DNA-binding regulation.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid catabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the alanine-to-oxaloacetate route into gluconeogenesis, alongside threonine, choline and carnitine-related amino acid metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid and one-carbon-related catabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern alanine metabolism and gluconeogenesis via oxaloacetate, i.e. channelling amino acid carbon into glucose, alongside threonine and choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis as further small-molecule catabolic routes.

shared: positive regulation of long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity

reading_1.theme: Synaptic plasticity and postsynaptic structure
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are activity-dependent synaptic plasticity and local synaptic translation, implemented through postsynaptic actin, density structure and receptor trafficking.

reading_2.theme: Synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are structural synaptic plasticity, long-term plasticity and local translation at synapses, framed as the mechanisms of activity-dependent synapse strengthening and maturation.

reading_1.theme: Cellular energy supply: glycolysis and phosphocreatine buffering
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange and the creatine/phosphocreatine shuttle, framed as the high-energy phosphate buffer linking mitochondrial ATP to cytosolic demand alongside glycolytic ATP production.

reading_2.theme: Cellular energy buffering and nucleotide cofactor interconversion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the phosphocreatine shuttle and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange, framed as energy transfer linked to interconversion of nucleotide and NAD cofactor pools.

reading_1.theme: Vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover quinone metabolism (vitamin K/menaquinone and ubiquinol synthesis and catabolism). Here they supply the vitamin K cofactor that gamma-carboxylates clotting factor precursors, next to fat-soluble vitamin E transport.

reading_2.theme: Isoprenoid-derived quinone, vitamin K and sterol metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are quinone metabolism (ubiquinol synthesis, vitamin K/menaquinone handling), framed as an isoprenoid side branch of the mevalonate pathway that also feeds cholesterol synthesis and CYP-mediated sterol catabolism.

shared: negative regulation of T cell receptor signaling pathway
Phosphorylation of CD3 and TCR zeta chains
Translocation of ZAP-70 to Immunological synapse

reading_1.theme: Lymphocyte antigen-receptor signalling, costimulation and inhibition
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the T cell side of antigen-receptor activation: CD3/ZAP-70 proximal signalling, CD28 costimulation, and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition. This runs parallel to BCR signalling and to inhibitory receptor brakes on leukocyte activation.

reading_2.theme: T cell receptor signalling, costimulation and development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe proximal TCR signalling with CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA coinhibition, framed as the signalling machinery governing T cell activation, thymic selection and differentiation.

shared: positive regulation of stress fiber assembly
positive regulation of focal adhesion assembly

reading_1.theme: Cell adhesion, actin stress fibres and cell migration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame syndecan and focal adhesion signalling with SRF-driven stress fibre formation as the adhesion-cytoskeletal machinery that enables substrate attachment, spreading and directed migration.

reading_2.theme: Fibroblast mechanotransduction and matrix remodeling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover Rho-driven stress fiber and focal adhesion assembly, syndecan signalling and SRF-target cytoskeletal remodeling. This is the mechanosensing apparatus that drives YAP/TAZ-dependent matrix production, EMT-like stromal activation and fibroblast migration.

shared: negative regulation of neuron projection regeneration
positive regulation of neuron projection regeneration

reading_1.theme: Axon sprouting and regeneration in peripheral nerve
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover injury-induced axon sprouting and regulated peripheral axon regeneration, framed alongside collateral sprouting as the general capacity of axons for growth plasticity.

reading_2.theme: Axon regeneration and growth control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are sprouting and regeneration of injured axons and their positive/negative regulation, framed as the outcome balanced by growth-stimulating versus RhoA- and ceramide-mediated inhibitory signalling.

reading_1.theme: NAD metabolism and mitochondrial energy carrier transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are nicotinate/NAD+ salvage and turnover, framed as NAD cofactor supply linked to mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and creatine phosphate energy buffering.

reading_2.theme: NAD+ metabolism from tryptophan and niacin
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are niacin-based pyridine nucleotide salvage and NAD+ turnover, the salvage complement to de novo NAD+ synthesis from tryptophan via kynurenine, in a context of redox and aldehyde detoxification.

shared: Apoptotic cleavage of cell adhesion  proteins

reading_1.theme: Cadherin-based cell-cell adhesion and junctions
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are adherens and apical junction adhesion structures, including their apoptotic cleavage, read here as the cadherin (CDH1/CDH11) calcium-dependent adhesion system whose trafficking and degradation are regulated.

reading_2.theme: Cadherin-based cell-cell adhesion and junctions
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are general cell junction and cell-cell adhesion modules, including apical junctions and their apoptotic cleavage, read here as cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) calcium-dependent adhesion regulated by trafficking and degradation.

positive regulation of leukocyte tethering or rolling
Progressive trimming of alpha-1,2-linked mannose residues from Man9/8/7GlcNAc2 to produce Man5GlcNAc2

Formation of the active cofactor, UDP-glucuronate
Reactions specific to the complex N-glycan synthesis pathway

reading_1.theme: Protein and lipid glycosylation in the Golgi
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe N- and O-glycan, sialyl/fucosyl, blood-group and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar transport, framed as the general glycosylation machinery that extends to proteoglycan/GAG, dystroglycan and Notch glycosylation and their disorders.

reading_2.theme: Glycan biosynthesis and glycoconjugate metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Golgi N-/O-glycosylation, glycosphingolipid and blood-group antigen synthesis and nucleotide-sugar transport (with CDG defects), framed as glycan building balanced by lysosomal glycan degradation and sugar-precursor metabolism.
